source: Aseprite Trial 1.3.18.6 (AppImage, observed black box) under Xvfb :78 1600x1000, screen_scale 2, 800 % zoom (16 screen px per cell), centre of each cell; inputs written by docs/PixelArt/ferramentas/trial_ase_selecao.py (public .ase spec), driven by trial_selecao.py (xdotool; quirks in its docstring), this file by trial_fixture_selecao.py. Aseprite source never read.
method: cell coords (x, y) are sprite pixels; a drag "press A release B" means press at the CENTRE of cell A and release at the centre of cell B (sub-cell sweeps: start/end cell = floor of the pointer). mask = selection read by Edit>Fill with opaque #FF00FF (1 = selected). Images: see ids legend.
ids_legend: xf*.ase: 1..19 = the shape pixel ids (inputs.xf_ids), 0 = transparent; sz/szb/pm: y*24+x of sz.ase, -2 = transparent; -1 = colour of no input (case then carries rgb rows, screen hex, composited on the checker if not opaque).

laws_observed.rect_marquee: cells from floor(press) to floor(release) INCLUSIVE on both axes, any drag direction, clipped to the sprite; a click without motion deselects (10/10)
laws_observed.ellipse_marquee: box = inclusive press..release cells; the filled shape equals Zingl plotEllipseRect (x0,y0,x1,y1) spans in 106/112 boxes; 4x6 5x6 6x5 10x6 10x8 24x16 are 1 px tighter at the top/bottom rows (tables here are the truth)
laws_observed.polygonal_lasso: even-odd interior sampled at cell centres (vertices at cell centres) UNION the Bresenham outline of every edge incl. the closing one (6/6 exact); freehand lasso = same rule over the mouse samples
laws_observed.modes: Shift add, Alt+Shift subtract, Ctrl+Shift intersect (equal to the bar buttons); Alt alone with the marquee = eyedropper; Ctrl = Move tool (drags the selected pixels)
laws_observed.select_menu: All = whole sprite; Reselect restores the last mask; Inverse = complement (of nothing = all); Deselect = Esc / ctrl+d
laws_observed.modify: expand = dilation, contract = erosion (sprite edge counts as OUTSIDE), border = mask - contract (INNER band, width n); square brush = (2n+1)^2 square; circle brush = the ellipse-marquee mask of a (2n+1)x(2n+1) box (n=1 plus, n=2 5x5 minus corners, n=3 a2+b2<=12) (90/90)
laws_observed.magic_wand: selected iff max(|dR|,|dG|,|dB|,|dA|) <= tolerance against the clicked RGBA (raw, no premultiply); when the clicked pixel has A=0 every A=0 pixel matches whatever its RGB; contiguous = flood fill 4/8 (Pixel Connectivity popup); non-contiguous = global (41+7 cases)
laws_observed.color_range: same law as the non-contiguous wand with the dialog colour (7/7)
laws_observed.flip: with a selection: mirror inside the selection bounds; without: whole sprite (= Flip Canvas)
laws_observed.edit_rotate: 180 in place; 90 of a w x h selection: new h x w block at (floor(cx - h/2), floor(cy - w/2)) with c = box centre, old area cleared; without selection: content rotated as the canvas would be (x'=H-1-y, y'=x for CW) but canvas size kept (clipped)
laws_observed.rotate_canvas: 90 CW/CCW swap w,h (x'=H-1-y,y'=x / x'=y,y'=W-1-x); 180 and flips in place
laws_observed.edit_shift: 1 px with wrap inside the selection bounds (needs a selection; ctrl+a = whole sprite)
laws_observed.transform: fields only with lifted pixels; positive angle = CCW on screen; 90 exact; scale by w/h fields = nearest with src = floor((d+0.5)*S/N), placed at floor(c - N/2); fast rotation is NOT a plain inverse-nearest map (best 12..19 cells off); RotSprite drops pixels of 1-px lines
laws_observed.sprite_size: nearest: src = floor(d*S/N); bilinear: aligned corners fx = d*(S-1)/(N-1), every channel within 1 of the float bilinear, truncation exact on 99 %; RotSprite = nearest at integer 2x, own pattern otherwise (source colours only)
laws_observed.canvas_size: anchor centre: left = trunc(dw/2), top = dh - trunc(dh/2); new area transparent, or the colour bar BACKGROUND colour (#000000 here) on a Background layer
laws_observed.crop: to the selection BOUNDS, pixels outside an elliptical mask kept
laws_observed.trim: removes transparent AND uniform opaque border (blue on a normal layer too)
laws_observed.paste: lands at the copied position (floating); Copy = active layer, Copy Merged = flattened visible

inputs.wand_note: ref (0,0) = 000000ff; column x=1..23 has d = wand_ds[x-1]; row 0 R+d, 1 G+d, 2 B+d, 3 A-d, 4 R+d G+d, 5 R+d G+d B+d, 6 R+d and A-d, 8 RGB=(d,d,d) A=0 (and (0,8) = 00000000)
inputs.trimc: trim with transparent -> 0000ffff (normal layer); trimcb the same on a Background layer
inputs.pm: bottom layer = sz, top layer (active) = 0000ffff for x < 12, transparent for x >= 12
